description: Shared Renovate policy for tgrecojr repos: 7-day cooldown, immutable pins, automerge only for aged non-major updates.

logLevelRemap.matchMessage: /did not have a releaseTimestamp, but as we're running with minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-optional/

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes: open the PR at once (visible, can be merged early by hand), automerge only when the fix is 7 days old.

packageRules.description: Group all minor and patch updates together.
Pinning freezes the version already in use and brings in no new code. A pin has no release date, so without this the pin PR would wait forever.
Digest updates may be raised at any time; the cooldown still applies where the registry provides a date.

Only Docker Hub gives Renovate a release date. Without this, images on GHCR, Quay and cgr.dev would be held forever. Docker Hub images are still aged 7 days; the others pass without an age check and need the repo's own cooldown status check.

uv only: Renovate cannot pass the cooldown to uv, so lockfile maintenance would be held forever. Exempt it here and set exclude-newer in pyproject.toml so uv enforces the cooldown itself. For npm, pnpm and Cargo there is deliberately no exemption: lockfile maintenance must keep the 7-day age, because that is the value Renovate passes to the package manager.

The organization's own shared workflows (chainringlabs/ci). The cooldown guards against third-party releases; this code is reviewed in its own repository before it is tagged, so its pins are raised at once, at any time, in a PR of their own that is not held back by other updates.
